steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: probe-fn
steps.eval: window.__wallFaceState = () => { let n = 0, mapped = 0, hidden = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const t = o.userData && o.userData.finishTarget; if (!t || t.kind !== 'wall') return; n++; if (o.material.map) mapped++; if (!o.visible) hidden++ }); return { n, mapped, hidden } }

steps.name: no-blank-faces-while-loading
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__wallFaceState(); console.log('[FINISH-DEFER mid]', JSON.stringify(s)); if (s.n === 0) throw new Error('no wall faces found'); if (s.hidden > 0) throw new Error('FINISH-DEFER regression: ' + s.hidden + '/' + s.n + ' wall faces hidden while the photo finish loads (bare wall body shows through)') })()

waitFor.store: (() => { const w = window.__wallFaceState(); return w.n > 0 && w.mapped === w.n })()
